commit_reason: Published supplemental script is distributed as ZIP, without a source commit. Content hash pins executable baseline.

published_configuration.published_runtime: OpenMM 7; GPU simulations used CUDA 7.5. Paper reports Titan X Pascal and Tesla K80 hardware; energy-drift subsection does not identify which GPU supplied Table 5.
published_configuration.system: DHFR explicit solvent, 23558 atoms including 7023 water molecules
published_configuration.nonbonded: PME; ewaldErrorTolerance=1e-5; other createSystem defaults, including nonbonded cutoff, inherited from installed OpenMM; switching enabled at 0.9 times cutoff
published_configuration.constraints: HBonds; rigid water inherited from createSystem default
published_configuration.initial_state: Published dhfr.pdb positions; velocities sampled at 300 K independently for each new Context
published_configuration.platform: CUDA; one Context at a time; no multi-device index specified

installation_limitations.reason: Published documentation gives unversioned installs; commands are preserved verbatim. They do not enforce the inspected compatibility release or historical configuration. No pinned install command or dependency lock is invented.
installation_limitations.source_build_reason: Released binary installation route documented; no source build required for that route.
